lines.text: The 1904 Olympic marathon was the most chaotic sporting event in human history.
Out of thirty-two runners, only fourteen finished alive.
The temperature was ninety degrees, on dirt roads covered in choking dust.
The guy who crossed the finish line first?
He quit at mile nine, hitched an eleven-mile ride in a car, and trotted across the line as a joke.
The actual gold medalist was fed raw rat poison and brandy by his trainers,
hallucinating wildly as two men dragged his limp legs across the finish.
A Cuban mailman showed up with no money, wearing heavy street boots and trousers.
He stopped at an orchard, ate rotten apples, took an hour-long nap on the grass,
and still finished in fourth place!
Another runner was chased an entire mile off-course by a pack of wild feral dogs.
Against all odds, he still finished ninth!
Organizers were so horrified they nearly banned the marathon forever.
